name: 64 - DB - Add Clinic Knowledge Documents and RAG

parameters.query:
CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pg_trgm;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS clinic_knowledge_documents (
  id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  clinic_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES clinics(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  service_id BIGINT REFERENCES services(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  title TEXT NOT NULL,
  source_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (source_type IN ('pdf','docx','txt','html','manual_text','qa','other')),
  original_filename TEXT,mime_type TEXT,
  specialty TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'general',topic TEXT,
  version_label TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '1.0',
  status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft' CHECK (status IN ('draft','processing','review','published','archived','failed')),
  source_priority INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 50 CHECK (source_priority BETWEEN 1 AND 100),
  raw_text TEXT,content_hash TEXT,
  allowed_use TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'patient_information' CHECK (allowed_use IN ('patient_information','pre_visit_guidance','post_visit_guidance','clinical_information','internal_only')),
  response_policy JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::JSONB,
  metadata JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::JSONB,
  valid_from DATE,valid_to DATE,approved_by TEXT,approved_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  UNIQUE(clinic_id,title,version_label)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS clinic_knowledge_chunks (
  id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  document_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES clinic_knowledge_documents(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  chunk_index INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (chunk_index>=0),
  page_start INTEGER,page_end INTEGER,section_title TEXT,
  content TEXT NOT NULL,content_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
  token_estimate INTEGER CHECK (token_estimate IS NULL OR token_estimate>=0),
  keywords JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::JSONB,
  embedding JSONB,embedding_model TEXT,embedding_dimensions INTEGER,
  embedding_status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'not_requested' CHECK (embedding_status IN ('not_requested','pending','ready','failed')),
  search_vector TSVECTOR GENERATED ALWAYS AS (TO_TSVECTOR('simple',COALESCE(section_title,'')||' '||COALESCE(content,''))) STORED,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  UNIQUE(document_id,chunk_index)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS clinic_knowledge_qa (
  id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  clinic_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES clinics(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  document_id BIGINT REFERENCES clinic_knowledge_documents(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  service_id BIGINT REFERENCES services(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  specialty TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'general',topic TEXT,
  question TEXT NOT NULL,answer TEXT NOT NULL,
  question_variants JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::JSONB,
  keywords JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::JSONB,
  requires_human_confirmation BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
  safety_category TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'general' CHECK (safety_category IN ('general','medication','post_procedure','urgent_if_red_flags','human_only')),
  source_priority INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 70 CHECK (source_priority BETWEEN 1 AND 100),
  status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft' CHECK (status IN ('draft','published','archived')),
  valid_from DATE,valid_to DATE,approved_by TEXT,approved_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS clinic_knowledge_ingestion_jobs (
  id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  document_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES clinic_knowledge_documents(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK (status IN ('pending','processing','completed','failed')),
  chunk_size_chars INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1800,
  overlap_chars INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 250,
  chunks_created INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,error_message TEXT,
  started_at TIMESTAMPTZ,completed_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS uq_knowledge_ingestion_document
ON clinic_knowledge_ingestion_jobs(document_id);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS clinical_knowledge_queries (
  id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  clinic_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES clinics(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  patient_id BIGINT REFERENCES patients(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  session_id BIGINT REFERENCES conversation_sessions(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  input_message_id BIGINT REFERENCES conversation_messages(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  clinical_intake_case_id BIGINT REFERENCES clinical_intake_cases(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  question TEXT NOT NULL,normalized_query TEXT,specialty TEXT,
  service_id BIGINT REFERENCES services(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  risk_flags JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::JSONB,
  retrieved_chunk_ids JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::JSONB,
  retrieved_qa_ids JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::JSONB,
  answer_text TEXT,citations JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::JSONB,
  answer_status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'retrieval_pending' CHECK (answer_status IN ('retrieval_pending','retrieved','answered','no_reliable_answer','human_review','urgent_handoff','failed')),
  model_provider TEXT,model_name TEXT,prompt_version TEXT,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_knowledge_documents_published ON clinic_knowledge_documents(clinic_id,status,specialty,source_priority DESC,updated_at DESC);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_knowledge_chunks_document ON clinic_knowledge_chunks(document_id,chunk_index);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_knowledge_chunks_search ON clinic_knowledge_chunks USING GIN(search_vector);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_knowledge_chunks_trgm ON clinic_knowledge_chunks USING GIN(content gin_trgm_ops);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_knowledge_qa_published ON clinic_knowledge_qa(clinic_id,status,specialty,source_priority DESC);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_knowledge_qa_question_trgm ON clinic_knowledge_qa USING GIN(question gin_trgm_ops);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_clinical_knowledge_queries_recent ON clinical_knowledge_queries(clinic_id,created_at DESC);

SELECT TRUE success,'migration_completed' result,'ساختار RAG و دانش تخصصی ایجاد شد.' message;

parameters.content:
## فقط یک‌بار اجرا شود

اسناد، Chunkها، Q&A، Job پردازش و Queryهای RAG ایجاد می‌شوند.

Embedding اختیاری است و Migration به pgvector وابسته نیست.
